# Repository About

The text for this repository's GitHub **About** panel (the ⚙️ next to "About" on the repo page).

## Description

Software KVM: control multiple computers with one keyboard and mouse, switching machines with a hotkey. Rust daemon + Flutter tray app, end-to-end encrypted (Noise + Ed25519).

## Topics

`kvm` `rust` `tokio` `flutter` `dart` `cross-platform` `keyboard-mouse-sharing` `input-sharing` `noise-protocol` `ed25519` `macos` `windows` `daemon`
